title: Add Rename Command to Repo CLI
description: Introduce a `repo rename` command that renames all occurrences of a token (and its case variants UPPER/lower/Title/snake_case/camelCase/etc.) across all non-git-ignored files. Usage: `repo rename "model" "representation"`. Must walk the repo, skip .gitignored files, rewrite both filenames (paths) and file contents, preserving casing per occurrence.
summary: Added `repo rename <old> <new>` command. Introduced Rename region in repo/cli/main.go with `applyRenameCasings` (three passes: UPPER, Title, lower substring replacement), `titleCaseToken` helper, `ToolRename` (walks rootDir, skips .git/node_modules/isGitIgnored, rewrites UTF-8 file contents, renames files/folders deepest-first), and `renameCommand` cobra wrapper. Registered in `NewRootWithConfig`. Added Rename test region in repo/cli/main_test.go with four tests (casing replacement, unrelated-content invariance, end-to-end file+folder rename respecting .gitignore, validation errors). All four tests pass; `go build ./...` clean.
